reading.action: Floor 2 (cleared): carry the brazier-stand to the exit cache, then DIVE for the sunken second iron bar
reading.result: CLEAN SUCCESS (margin 24). Smart approach (cached gear first = dived light) + leg-driven kick (Hiker's Legs). Retrieved BOTH sunken items: 2nd iron bar (atk 4, spare/offhand) + smooth river-stone (good thrown, FIN). Surfaced clean — no drowning scare, no HP loss; cost is the cold/exertion of the dive: Stamina 51->45 (-6). Focus unaffected (physical, not channel). Brazier-stand (fire source: basket+dry char+flint striker) relocated to the exit cache, char kept dry. Items acquired: brazier-stand, 2nd iron bar, river-stone. The water is fully looted now; cistern cleared + stripped. NO Tower reset.
